records.issue_text: pkg/plugins/log/fake.go:47 — TestLogger.FromContext` returns an unrelated logger, so callers such as the updated request logger write into an inaccessible fake and existing tests can no longer inspect emitted logs.
records.rationale: The finding is accurate. In fake.go:46-48, `FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()` which creates a brand new, unrelated TestLogger instance. When LoggerMiddleware calls `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)` (logger_middleware.go:61), if the logger is a TestLogger, the log output goes to this new instance rather than the original TestLogger that tests would be inspecting. This breaks test assertions that check `f.InfoLogs` or similar fields on the original TestLogger, since those fields remain empty while the new logger receives the calls.
